Sales Invoice

The Sales Invoice view displays comprehensive details about a specific sales invoice, including customer information, line items, totals, and payment status.

This view provides a complete overview of the invoice as it appears to customers, showing all relevant transaction details and amounts.

Available Actions

From this view, you can perform several actions using the buttons at the bottom of the screen:

• Click Edit to modify the invoice details, line items, or amounts

• Click Email to send the invoice directly to the customer's email address

• Click Print to generate a printable version of the invoice

• Click New Receipt to record a payment against this invoice

• Click Copy To to duplicate this invoice to a new sales invoice or recurring invoice

Invoice Status Indicators

The view automatically displays the payment status of the invoice:

• Paid in Full appears in green when the invoice has been completely paid

• Overdue appears in red when the invoice is past its due date and has an outstanding balance

• The balance due amount shows how much the customer still owes

Special Features

Additional information may appear based on your invoice settings:

• Early payment discounts are displayed if configured, showing the reduced amount due if paid by a specific date

• Total amount in words converts the numeric total to written text for clarity

• Total amount in base currency shows the equivalent value when dealing with foreign currency invoices

To learn about creating and editing sales invoices, see: Sales Invoice — Edit
